Parse a Campbell .dld Final Storage Label file

dot-parse_campbell_dld.Rd

Extracts Output_Table column definitions from the label section of a Campbell Scientific .dld file.

Usage

.parse_campbell_dld(fname_dld)

Arguments

fname_dld

Path to the .dld file.

Value

A named list (keyed by declared table ID) where each element is a character vector of column names. Column 1 (the stored table ID) is renamed "table_id"; _RTM columns become "day_of_year" and "time_hhmm".
